Rae (CSM): Quick flag  SummitBridge QBR = Tue 9am PT. Need final deck + one-pager runbook by Mon 3pm. Key asks: health snapshot, onboarding gaps, renewal risks, enablement plan, and owners for feedback.

Ben (CS Ops): I'll pull MAU, error rate, and a 30d incident mini-timeline. Which NPS do we use for execs? product or support?

Iris (AE): Use product NPS for exec sentiment. Renewal posture: pilot converting but legal delay. Risk: amber. I'll draft mitigation (exec 15m, demo, legal checklist).

Noor (Enablement): I'll run a 30-min enablement office hour Mon 11am PT and drop a 6-min recording + checklist. Link will go to /drive/summitbridge/enablement.

Kai (SE): For onboarding blockers, I'll paste two short queries and a CSV of pending tasks, plus a perf-snapshot PNG.

Rae (CSM): Action items (reply DONE):
- Ben: Health slide with MAU + incidents (due Mon 3pm)
- Kai: Adoption CSV + perf PNG (due Mon noon)
- Noor: Recording + checklist (due Mon 3pm)
- Iris: Renewal slide + sponsor ask (due Mon 3pm)
- Rae: One-pager runbook + speaking bullets (due Mon 3pm)

deck-bot: Reminder set: upload final deck 24h before meeting.
